parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A wooden shelf located in the middle section of the table, used for storage or support.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage space and structural support to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A left vertical side panel made of wood, forming part of the table’s support structure.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and connects to other structural components.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed, provides stability and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A right vertical side panel made of wood, forming part of the table’s support structure.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and connects to other structural components.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed, provides stability and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A curved wooden connector that links the tabletop to the side panels.
parts.Functional_description: Distributes load between the tabletop and side panels, enhancing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed, acts as a rigid connector without movement.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A small wooden drawer located under the tabletop for storing small items.
parts.Functional_description: Provides storage space for accessories or documents.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: A lower wooden shelf integrated into the table’s curved structure.
parts.Functional_description: Used for holding books, decorations, or other items.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed, does not move during use.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The main flat wooden surface of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides the primary working or display surface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed, does not move during normal use.
